events.SettingsCategoryToggled: User expands or collapses a settings category group
events.MintAdded: User adds a new mint URL to their connected mints
events.MintRemoved: User removes a non-default mint from their list
events.SeedPhraseViewed: User views their wallet seed phrase after confirmation
events.NostrExtensionConnected: User successfully connects via NIP-07 browser extension
events.NostrNsecConnected: User successfully connects via nsec private key
events.NostrProfileFetched: Nostr profile fetched and displayed after key provided
events.RelayAdded: User adds a new Nostr relay URL
events.RelayRemoved: User removes a Nostr relay from their list
